name: Build Apple
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Branch/Tag to build'
        required: true
        default: 'master'
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build_ios:
    name: iOS
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout application
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Xcode setup
        uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: latest-stable

      - name: Common flutter setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-common

      - name: Build .app
        run: |
          flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
          cd build/ios/iphoneos
          zip -r Runner.app.zip Runner.app

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: builds-ios
          path: build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app.zip

  build_ipa:
    name: IPA
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout application
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Xcode setup
        uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: latest-stable

      - name: Common flutter setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-common

      - name: Build .xcarchive
        run: |
          flutter build ipa --release --no-codesign
          cd build/ios/archive
          zip -r Runner.xcarchive.zip Runner.xcarchive

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: builds-ipa
          path: build/ios/archive/Runner.xcarchive.zip

  build_macos:
    name: macOS
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout application
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Xcode setup
        uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: latest-stable

      - name: Common flutter setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-common

      - name: Build .app
        run: |
          flutter build macos --release
          cd build/macos/Build/Products/Release
          zip -r wger.app.zip wger.app

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: builds-macos
          path: build/macos/Build/Products/Release/wger.app.zip

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
